camel_example: aliyun contactcenterai POST /llm-ik000000RVYCKzt/ccai/app/097d65c9c7004f8dad2b454850ac232b/completion_message --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"Messages":[{"Role":"user","Content":"如Role=system ,Content=You are a helpful assistant.\nRole=user , Content=请阅读以下对话内容，按照要求执行指令任务。"}]}' --version 2024-06-03 --force
description_en: Calls the Tongyi Xiaomi CCAI - Conversation Analysis AIO application in the Message protocol format to retrieve conversation summaries, extract key information, obtain quality inspection results, and analyze conversations. The application supports HTTP calls to respond to clients and provides both standard HTTP and HTTP Server-Sent Events (SSE) protocols. You can select a protocol based on your requirements
description_zh: 支持以Message协议格式调用通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO应用获取对话摘要、关键信息抽取、质检结果、对话分析结果，应用调用支持 HTTP 调用来完成客户的响应，目前提供普通 HTTP 和 HTTP SSE 两种协议，您可根据自己的需求自行选择
kebab_example: aliyun contactcenterai run-completion-message --workspace-id llm-ik000000RVYCKzt --app-id 097d65c9c7004f8dad2b454850ac232b --messages '[{"Role":"user","Content":"如Role=system ,Content=You are a helpful assistant.\nRole=user , Content=请阅读以下对话内容，按照要求执行指令任务。"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunCompletionMessage

fields.help_en:
The conversation role. Valid values:
user: customer.
assistant: customer service representative.
system: system message.
function: function
fields.help_zh: （通话角色）对以下枚举进行校验： user-客户 assistant-客服 system-系统消息 function-函数
fields.name: role
